dedupe_keys.name: ics add smart industry testbed dataset for cyber physical security monitoring testing university of genova

description: ICS-ADD is a traffic capture of an industrial control system testbed subjected to simulated cyber attacks, including denial of service, man-in-the-middle and malware infiltration. The IEEE DataPort page and DataCite record say that besides raw network traffic it gives the output of two open-source security monitoring tools, OSSIM and Suricata, so detection by existing tools can be compared, and list CSV, PCAP, TXT and ZIP files. It was submitted by Giovanni Battista Gaggero and Alessandro Armellin of the University of Genova and last updated on 16 May 2024. DataCite gives the licence as CC BY 4.0, but the page marks it a Standard Dataset, so the files need an IEEE DataPort subscription (US$40 a month, free for IEEE Society members). Coverage is one laboratory smart industry testbed. Caveats: the attacks are staged, and the testbed layout, recording length and file sizes are not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives labelled attack traffic and security tool alerts to test intrusion detection and to set detection delays in models of cyber attacks on factory control systems. Related catalogue records include the ICS SCADA cyber kit testbed traffic and the Industry 4.0 production line digital twin under attack.
